faq.question: Q1. What is AOC Group C Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: AOC Group C Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive conducted by Army Ordnance Corps for filling 2615 Civilian Group C posts including Tradesman Mate, Fireman, JOA, MTS and Material Assistant.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AOC Group C Vacancy 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 2615 vacancies are available under AOC Group C Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for AOC Group C Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The qualification varies according to the post. Candidates must have 10th pass, 12th pass with typing skills, or a Bachelor's Degree depending on the post applied for.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for AOC Group C Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 22 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of AOC Group C posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Pay Level-1 to Pay Level-5 depending on the post, with pay ranging from ₹18,000 to ₹92,300.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for AOC Group C Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes written examination, physical efficiency test wherever applicable, typing test for JOA, document verification and medical examination.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for AOC Group C Vacancy 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official AOC recruitment portal after the application link is activated.
